text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Jardiance are urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections (UTIs) and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning when you pee, urgent need to go, or cloudy urine.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, redness, or discharge in women and men.
Increased urination: Going to the bathroom more often because the drug removes extra sugar through your kidneys.
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Feeling thirsty or lightheaded from fluid loss.
Upper respiratory tract infections: Mild stuffy nose or sore throat.

text_blocks.snippet: Get medical help right away if you notice any rare but dangerous reactions:

list.snippet: Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): Too much acid in the blood, causing nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and trouble breathing.
Severe genital infections (Fournier's gangrene): Extreme pain, swelling, or redness in the area between the genitals and anus.
Severe dehydration or kidney problems: Feeling very dizzy, fainting, or sudden drops in urine output.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): Shaking, sweating, or confusion—mostly if taken with insulin or other diabetes drugs.

text_blocks.snippet: For official prescribing details, check the Boehringer Ingelheim Patient Hub. You can also report adverse events to the FDA Safety Reporting Page or call 1-800-FDA-1088.
